description: The file defines the CatalogItem class, a model representing items in a catalog with properties such as Id, Name, Description, Price, and image data handling methods. It appears to be part of a Blazor project for managing catalog items.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents a catalog item with properties for identification, categorization, description, pricing, and associated image data. Includes methods for validating and converting image data.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates whether the provided image file name and base64 data meet size and extension criteria.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Converts a file item to a base64 encoded string asynchronously.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks whether the file extension is one of the allowed image types.
